speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are here to discuss a dermatological concern; please describe the specific lesion(s) you are worried about, including when they first appeared and how they have changed. To begin our assessment, how would you describe the size, color, shape, and any symptoms like itching or bleeding?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (likely arising from chronic syphilis or smoking-related damage).
